title: The Latest Crier for Sep 05, 2026
items:
Major Day: Explore. Discover. Declare!

Tuesday, September 22 | 11:00 a.m.--12:30 p.m. | BMW Rooms & Atrium, Maytag Not sure what you want to major or minor in? Major Day is the perfect place to start! First- and second-year students are invited to explore majors and minors, connect with faculty, ask questions, and discover new possibilities. Whether you're still exploring or ready to declare, this is a great opportunity to take the next step toward finding an academic path that fits your interests and goals. 
Come curious, bring your questions, and see where your interests can take you! We hope to see you at Major Day!

Slip n Slide Kickball

Looking for something to do this weekend? Join Campus Activities Board on Saturday, September 5th from 2-4pm, between Hislop and the Pods for Slip n Slide Kickball! See you there!

Weekly Prayer! (30 minutes)

Struggling or feeling burdened? Want to pray over your friends, campus, & the world? This is the place for you. Meet in the Chapel, every Thursday at 11 am to pray as a community! It doesn’t take much, just bring yourself & an open heart. "This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us." 1 John 5:14

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 9/6/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 

Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, October 13th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.
